list.content: ## Gloves are essential to being “food safe” by adding an extra layer of protection between your hands and food. Gloves protect the food from your hands, not keep your hands clean.
list.title: Purpose

list.content: ## ✔ Wash hands before putting on gloves ## ✔ Change gloves when you change food (change gloves between handling meat and vegetables) ## ✔ Use tongs instead of gloves, if possible
list.title: Do's

list.content:
## <sb>✘</sb> Touch anything other than food (hair, face, broom, floors)
## <sb>✘</sb>  Handle money while wearing gloves
## <sb>✘</sb> Wear gloves when cleaning or carrying dishes
## <sb>✘</sb> Wear gloves when serving customers (always take them off, then wear fresh gloves when you return to food handling)
list.title: Don'ts

data.title: <sb>Tip #1:</sb> **Wear Gloves**

slides.templateDescription: Highlight important details in an image

waypoints.caption: ## Wash your hands for **40-60 seconds**. Here are the guidelines for washing hands:
## Apply enough soap to all hand surfaces.
## Put right palm over left dorsum with interlaced fingers and vice-versa.
## Place palm to palm with fingers interlaced.
## Put the back of fingers to opposing palms with fingers interlocked.
## Make a rotational rubbing of left thumb clasped in right palm and vice-versa.
## Make a rotational rubbing, backwards and forwards with clasped fingers of right hand in palm and vice-versa.
## Dry thoroughly with a single-use towel.
## Use a towel to turn off the faucet.
## Dry your hands using a towel.

images.caption: ## Food handlers must **tell **their **supervisors **about any infections or conditions that may result in discharges. They may make food unsafe for people to eat because of their conditions.
## It is possible to take precautions so conditions **do not affect food quality**. For example, cover an infected sore with a waterproof covering.
## If food handlers are unwell or have injuries, **stay at work to do other tasks**. They must do everything reasonable to avoid contaminating any food.

items.caption: ## As a team member at Roll'd, your **appearance and presentation** to our customers are critically important.
## Each team member must present a neat, clean, professional, and fun Roll'd image that meets the same standards regardless of where they work.
Management must wear a black collar shirt short or long sleeves.
Front-of-house (service) team members must wear a Fresh tee and when rolling a FOH apron.
## **Back-of-house** (kitchen) team members must wear a black apron.

images.content: ## Keep your **hands clean**. Make sure the nails are short and neat and have no nail polish.
## **Perfumes or after-shaves** with subtle fragrances are permitted.
## We recommend a good **antiperspirant/deodorant** as it gets hot behind the counter when it gets busy.
## **Hair** should be **clean and tied back** into a tight bun (for females) and under a cap (for males).
## All men must present a **clean-shaven appearance** with any sideburns, goatees or other facial hair neatly trimmed.
